notablePrerequisites: You control at least three other Islands.
description:
Activate Mishra's Bauble by tapping and sacrificing it, looking at the top card of a player's library and drawing a card at the beginning of the next turn's upkeep.
Activate Tameshi by paying {W} and returning Mystic Sanctuary to your hand, returning Mishra's Bauble from graveyard to the battlefield.
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying {4}{U}{U}, taking an extra turn after this one.
Play Mystic Sanctuary.
Mystic Sanctuary enters the battlefield, putting Walk the Aeons from your graveyard to the top of your library.
Cast Mishra's Bauble by paying {0}.
Move to your next turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Mishra's Bauble triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.
